cards.title: Top of the Ladder
cards.instruction: Carry yourself as the highest-status person present. Treat questions as requests for your approval.

cards.title: Close It Properly
cards.instruction: Keep them present until both of you complete the ritual that formally ends this role, meeting, or relationship.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll decide how we handle this. Before you hand in your shop keys, we do the farewell bell.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'm leaving because the bell rings constantly.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You can question the details after my decision. Precisely. This is the last one you have to answer.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: We ring it together. Leaving is still a team activity.

cardFidelity.evidence: A1 conditions key return on bell; A3 decides one last answer is required; A5 denies B4 unilateral ringing solution by specifying joint participation.

heightening.evidence: A5 uses B4 offered solo ringing to make mutual closure explicit, raising participation rather than adding a new unrelated obstacle.
